# FLATTEN_EXACT (auto-generated by code/th_algo/fl_report.py at 2026-11-28 08:36Z; W-DYNQ with W-PLAN-AS)

Exact engine, 42 months (Nov 2025 excluded), live lots; treated vs reference: M = live mix as run (fixed bracket + Trade Health + bell flatten), A = book alone vs fix_A, N = mix without the book Trade Health vs fix_N. Drawdown first. max DD / worst week are negative dollars (closer to 0 = shallower). Win = shallower max DD and worst week with income not lower by more than 10%, or more income with DD not deeper. years won = of the years with data (2023..2026). fwd = forward 13 / 4 / 2 week periods: periods with DD or worst week better / periods, verdict. pess = income with Stop exits worse by the DS3_DN_STOPFILL slippage.
